title: Sycophancy Pressure Resilience Across Reasoning vs. Non-Reasoning Models

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Direct practical impact: if extended thinking reduces sycophancy, this provides an immediately deployable mitigation. The GPT-5 data suggests this effect exists; isolating it from other training differences is valuable for the field.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Clean A/B comparison using API toggles for reasoning mode. Models with toggleable thinking (Claude, GPT) are accessible via standard APIs. No model internals needed. Beginners can design and run this with basic API skills.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single variable (reasoning on/off), matched sycophancy probes, clear deliverable (capitulation rate comparison). Well-defined and easily completable in 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
